Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Thanks for coming in. How do you keep on top of your energy at home?

Speaker: Grace Okafor
Text: I've got a smart meter so it sends the readings itself. I mainly look at the app to see what we're using.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Tell me about the last time you opened the app.

Speaker: Grace Okafor
Text: Yesterday. I wanted to see if the new heater was using a lot. The graph only shows days, not hours, so I couldn't tell when the heater was on.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Has the smart meter ever stopped sending readings?

Speaker: Grace Okafor
Text: Once, last winter. It went offline for two months and nobody told me. I only noticed because the app said the last reading was in November. I had to send them manually after that until an engineer came.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: How did you remember to send them manually?

Speaker: Grace Okafor
Text: I put a reminder in my own calendar for the first of the month, because their text arrives at random times.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: If there was a notification when your usage spiked, would you want that?

Speaker: Grace Okafor
Text: Yes, I think I'd like that.
